summary: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或状态：昨天、上周、去年……动词要用过去式。

rules.title: 动词过去式的构成
rules.detail: 规则变化：一般加 ed（work → worked）；以 e 结尾加 d（live → lived）；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 ed（study → studied）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音加 ed（stop → stopped）。不规则变化需要单独记忆：go → went，have → had，see → saw 等。

examples.en: I visited my grandparents last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我看望了祖父母。

examples.en: We went to the beach yesterday.

rules.title: 否定句与疑问句：借助 did
rules.detail: did 后面的动词要还原为原形！否定：didn't + 动词原形；疑问：Did + 主语 + 动词原形？be 动词除外：was / were 直接变否定和疑问。

examples.en: I didn't watch TV last night.
Did you play soccer yesterday afternoon?
examples.zh: 昨天下午你踢足球了吗？

pitfalls: did 后动词没还原：❌ Did you went there? → ✓ Did you go there?
yesterday 出现还用原形：❌ I see a film yesterday. → ✓ I saw a film yesterday.
was / were 混用：❌ They was happy. → ✓ They were happy.

questions.stem: I ___ my homework an hour ago.
questions.explain: an hour ago（一小时前）是一般过去时标志词，finish 变 finished。

questions.stem: — Where ___ you go last summer? — I ___ to Qingdao.
questions.explain: last summer 是过去时，疑问句用 did + 原形 go；回答用过去式 went。

questions.stem: There ___ a lot of people in the park last Sunday.
questions.explain: people 是复数，last Sunday 是过去时间，be 动词用 were。

questions.stem: ___ your mother at home yesterday evening?
questions.explain: your mother 是单数，且句中无行为动词，用 be 动词过去式 was。

questions.stem: We ___ (buy) some books in the bookstore last Friday.
questions.explain: buy 是不规则动词，过去式为 bought。

questions.stem: She didn't ___ (come) to school yesterday because she was ill.
questions.explain: didn't 后动词用原形 come。
stop 是重读闭音节，双写 p 再加 ed：stopped。

questions.stem: Did you saw the new movie last night?
questions.explain: did 后面的动词必须还原为原形 see。

questions.stem: 昨天我给我的朋友写了一封信。（翻译整句）
answer: I wrote a letter to my friend yesterday.
Yesterday I wrote a letter to my friend.
questions.explain: write 的过去式是 wrote；yesterday 可放句首或句尾。

questions.stem: 上周末他们没有去野餐。（翻译整句，picnic 野餐，go for a picnic）
answer: They didn't go for a picnic last weekend.
They did not go for a picnic last weekend.
questions.explain: didn't + 动词原形 go；picnic 前习惯用 go for a picnic。
